interpretation: Dependencies are readiness requirements, not a released queue. No worker count, GPU capacity, physical coordinates or physical-time mapping is assigned.

order_assignment.confirmation_algorithm: Sort C01-C24 by digest (block ID tie-break); assign the 24 lexicographic permutations in that order.
order_assignment.input: ASCII namespace + ':' + layout_pair_id; SHA-256 hexadecimal digest
order_assignment.pilot_development_algorithm: Interpret complete digest as unsigned hexadecimal integer; index modulo 24 into the same permutation list.

pilot_waiver_policy: A waiver requires a separate verified four-condition exact-runtime record; no waived cell becomes an executed episode. This prepared schedule contains no waiver.
